intro: Garek has heard from Sigrun how much you have helped, and asks for your help in turn. Garek's master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, sent Garek to stop whatever is brewing in Lethlor Ravine, and first a stolen Sign of the Earth must be found.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I heard from Sigrun that you have been a great help to him. Perhaps I might enlist your help. I was sent here by my master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, to put an end to the trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine.
I cannot divulge the exact nature of my assignment here or the tasks that I must undertake, but be assured it is of vital importance.
A band of wandering ogres, sometimes seen near Camp Boff, stole an object called the Sign of the Earth; I must have it. Bring it to me, and I will tell you more.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The nomadic band of ogres travels between their camps across the Badlands; heat rising from the dry earth and the swirling winds will make it difficult to track their progress. I have heard that sometimes they travel through Camp Boff. If you are lost, you might try your search there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good tidings you bring bearing the Sign, friend. The Sign of the Earth was created by the Dark Iron dwarves of Angor Fortress to bind two of Deathwing's ruthless lieutenants, the twins Blacklash and Hematus.
